reason: A front-end DeepSeek Harness plugin for immersive focus that toggles a zen layout, hides and restores interface chrome, provides status-focused HUD elements, and signals companion-plugin state changes.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 提供禅模式，通过快捷键或按钮隐藏和恢复侧栏、顶栏及相关界面元素，并显示简化的工作状态信息。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness WebUI plugin that provides a zen mode with a button or shortcut to hide and restore interface chrome while showing simplified work-status information.

capabilities: modifies the DeepSeek Harness WebUI layout
adds a zen-mode toggle button and keyboard shortcut
hides and restores detected sidebar and topbar elements
dispatches a custom event for integration with companion plugins
exposes a runtime pause control that invokes the native stop action
